summary: Create a custom role under Access Management > Roles > Create role with a unique name, description, resource type (in the right component) and permissions, consolidating needed access into one assignment.
questions: How do I create a custom role in AAP 2.6?
When should I create a custom role?
How do I pick permissions for a role?

answer_card.title: Create a custom role
answer_card.answer_md:
1. **Access Management > Roles > Create role**.
2. Enter a specific **Name** and **Description**.
3. Choose the **Resource Type** in the correct component (projects and credentials exist in both execution and decisions).
4. Select **Permissions** and click **Create role**.
